controles.affirmation: Hook: 'Au deuxieme trimestre 2026... Depuis, six actions en justice d'actionnaires ont ete deposees, un fonds activiste a obtenu un siege au conseil et la societe a lance un plan de suppression de postes de 300 a 350 M$'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 FY2026: Kim deposee le 31 octobre 2025, New England Teamsters le 25 novembre 2025, Taylor le 22 decembre 2025, City of Sterling Heights le 30 decembre 2025, Podems le 24 fevrier 2026, Brooks le 5 mars 2026. Plan de restructuration: 'In November 2025, we initiated a restructuring plan'. Le T2 de l'exercice 2026 court du 1er fevrier au 30 avril 2026.
controles.correction_proposee: Quatre des six actions et le plan de restructuration sont anterieurs au trimestre, pas posterieurs. Seule l'arrivee d'Elliott (26 mai 2026) est reellement posterieure. Reformuler par exemple: 'Sur la meme periode, six actions d'actionnaires deposees depuis octobre 2025 visent la division Design IP, un plan de suppression de postes de 300 a 350 M$ est en cours, et un fonds activiste vient d'obtenir un siege au conseil.' Le corps de l'ATT donne deja la bonne chronologie.

controles.affirmation: Six procedures d'actionnaires (3 actions de groupe: Kim, New England Teamsters, City of Sterling Heights; 3 actions derivees: Taylor, Podems, Brooks), toutes sur la performance de Design IP, deux visant les anciens actionnaires d'Ansys; aucune provision comptabilisee

controles.affirmation: Accord de cooperation Elliott du 26 mai 2026: siege supplementaire, Jesse Cohn administrateur au 1er juin 2026 et membre du comite de gouvernance et des nominations; plafond de 4,9% du capital et 7,5% d'exposition economique
controles.verbatim_source: the Board of Directors of Synopsys agreed to increase the size of the Board by one, appoint Jesse Cohn to the Board, effective as of June 1, 2026 ; The Board also agreed to appoint Mr. Cohn to the Corporate Governance and Nominating Committee ; Elliott will not acquire in excess of 4.9% beneficial ownership of or 7.5% aggregate economic exposure to Synopsys' outstanding common stock, during the Cooperation Period (8-K du 27 mai 2026)

controles.affirmation: Restrictions BIS: lettre du 29 mai 2025 imposant une licence d'exportation vers la Chine, levee le 2 juillet 2025; politique nationale chinoise et fonds publics pour batir des capacites EDA independantes
controles.verbatim_source: on May 29, 2025, Synopsys received a so-called 'is-informed' letter from the BIS imposing a license requirement for the export, reexport, or in-country transfer of EDA software and technology... (the Q3 2025 BIS Restrictions). The Q3 2025 BIS Restrictions were subsequently rescinded on July 2, 2025. ; 'China has implemented national policies favoring Chinese companies and has formed government-backed investment funds as it seeks to build independent EDA capabilities'

controles.affirmation: Depart de Janet Lee, directrice juridique et secretaire generale, annonce le 12 aout 2026, effectif au plus tard le 31 decembre 2026
controles.verbatim_source: On August 12, 2026, Synopsys, Inc. announced that Janet Lee will no longer serve as Synopsys' General Counsel and Corporate Secretary, effective as of the earlier of (i) December 31, 2026, and (ii) the appointment of her successor. (8-K du 12 aout 2026)

controles.affirmation: Aveu d'execution interne sur Design IP et croissance atone attendue en 2026
controles.verbatim_source: weakness in our Design IP segment, due to several headwinds, including China export control restrictions, such as the Q3 2025 BIS Restrictions, which disrupted customer design starts in China, weaker than expected demand from a major foundry customer, and certain roadmap and resource decisions that did not yield their intended results. We have begun taking actions to sharpen our execution and reallocate resources to the highest growth opportunities in our Design IP segment, but expect to see muted growth in fiscal 2026.
